transition.evidence: The camera pulls the viewer into the next world: a soft rising air that ends as the world arrives.

stamp.evidence: A low landing when a world arrives or the reel appears; kept well under the air so the take stays soft.

swap.evidence: A shape morphs into the next one (tile into field, card into reel, phone into the next reel): a soft air pass.

click.evidence: Every cursor press that changes something on screen.

type.evidence: One quiet tick for each word that is typed into the field.

count.evidence: A quiet tick for each number step and each reel caption word that lights up.

reveal.evidence: A step badge, a finished job or a platform chip popping in.
